items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 17 at 2:30PM EST until November 20 at 3:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 knots with occasional gusts to Gale
force. Seas building 8 to 13 feet.

* WHERE...Atlantic coastal waters out to 60 nm.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
